items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I see Charlie all the time.

ctx.x: But it seems to me that before that, if I listen to the records, Eddie Powers was playing good, and Bordello.
Yeah, well, you know, there's another guy that doesn't mention much, Charlie Codello. Yeah. I see Charlie all the time.
I never met Lester Nelson, and I never heard him. What was he like? I was playing with Lester and Harry, man. I'm sure that's a bitch.
